review_scope: Read-only review of audit_scaler_symbolic.py, scaler_static_audit.json, execution_receipt.json; independently verified input size and SHA-256. No pickle/joblib deserialization, model construction, forward, training, or testing.

checks.symbolic_stack_and_memo_key_value_mappin: PASS: SETITEMS builds inert dict state; BUILD attaches it to inert symbols; final root state is checked for with_mean, with_std, n_features_in_, _sklearn_version, mean_, var_, scale_. Duplicate and non-string keys are rejected.
checks.wrapper_shape_dtype_endian_order_alignme: PASS: all three wrappers require exact schema; shape (1,) with int dimension, dtype Symbol args ('f8', False, True), dtype BUILD state with '<' byteorder, C order, alignment 16; parser checks exact padding count/bytes and reads exactly 8 scalar bytes at recorded offsets.
checks.global_execution_boundary: PASS: STACK_GLOBAL resolves strings/memo to an allowlist and creates a local Global descriptor; REDUCE/NEWOBJ only produce local Symbol descriptors; no source global is invoked or imported.
checks.mutation_rejection_selftests: PASS: 9/9 rejected (truncated, trailing, unapproved opcode, unknown global, feature count, wrong flag, wrong shape, wrong dtype, nonfinite scalar).

traceability_note: The result JSON reports field values but omits per-field key/value opcode offsets. The parser's symbolic SETITEMS/BUILD semantics do establish key-to-value assignment correspondence; adding those offsets would make the receipt easier to audit but is not required to support the reported values.
limitations: Static scaler bytes do not establish data-split provenance or preprocessing/inverse-transform equivalence.
This review does not authorize model construction, checkpoint loading, forward, validation, or testing.
The root-owned report remains subject to root's final scientific judgment.
